facts.fact: Consumer protection law n°2015-036 of 16 July 2015 (published in the Journal officiel of 7 August 2015) sets rules for distance sales including by electronic means, bans email advertising without consent, and states that an electronic-form contract is validly concluded under the law on electronic exchange of legal data; it covers online selling only in part.
